name: Youki Toubatsu Ninpou Chou
source:
It is about a ninja girl sent out to find out why her sister ninja didn't come back from a mission. She found out why very soon, and if she can't win the fights, she will find out even more. If she succeeds in the 5 fights, including the beginning test fight, she can rescue her sister ninja. Failure means joining her as a slave.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一名女忍奉命尋找執行任務後遲遲未歸的忍者姊姊。她很快便查明瞭姊姊失蹤的原因；如果無法贏得戰鬥，她還會親身體會更多真相。包括開場的測試戰在內，只要贏下五場戰鬥，她就能救出姊姊；一旦失敗，自己也會淪為奴隸，與姊姊為伴。

[內容取自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
